name: ORIENT
recent: Oriental Holdings 于11月宣布每股20仙的中期股息，并完成以4.11亿令吉收购Northam Georgetown、Bayview Hotel Georgetown、Wisma Boon Siew及Bayview Hotel Langkawi的相关交易。同期，大股东及董事出现多笔股权变动，包括Dato' Sri Loh Kian Chong、Dato' Seri Lim Su Tong及Dato' Sri Datuk Wira Tan Hui Jing的间接持股转让。
notable: 宣布每股20仙的单层中期股息，除息日为2026年11月16日，派发日为2026年11月25日。
完成以4.11亿令吉现金收购Northam Georgetown、Bayview Hotel Georgetown、Wisma Boon Siew及Bayview Hotel Langkawi。
大股东及董事在2026年11月5日进行多笔间接持股转让，涉及Dato' Sri Loh Kian Chong、Dato' Seri Lim Su Tong及Dato' Sri Datuk Wira Tan Hui Jing。
risks: Datin Loh Ean (Deceased) 及 Loh Ean Holdings Sdn Bhd 于2026年11月11日发出停止成为大股东的通知。
Dato' Wong Lum Kong 于2026年11月11日发出停止成为大股东的通知。

recent_en: Oriental Holdings announced an interim dividend of 20 sen per share in November and completed the RM411 million acquisitions of Northam Georgetown, Bayview Hotel Georgetown, Wisma Boon Siew and Bayview Hotel Langkawi. During the same period, there were multiple changes in substantial shareholders' and directors' interests, including indirect share transfers by Dato' Sri Loh Kian Chong, Dato' Seri Lim Su Tong and Dato' Sri Datuk Wira Tan Hui Jing.
notable_en: Declared an interim single-tier dividend of 20 sen per share, with ex-date on 16 November 2026 and payment date on 25 November 2026.
Completed the RM411 million cash acquisitions of Northam Georgetown, Bayview Hotel Georgetown, Wisma Boon Siew and Bayview Hotel Langkawi.

Substantial shareholders and directors conducted multiple indirect share transfers on 5 November 2026, involving Dato' Sri Loh Kian Chong, Dato' Seri Lim Su Tong and Dato' Sri Datuk Wira Tan Hui Jing.
risks_en: Datin Loh Ean (Deceased) and Loh Ean Holdings Sdn Bhd issued notices of ceasing to be substantial shareholders on 11 November 2026.
Dato' Wong Lum Kong issued a notice of ceasing to be a substantial shareholder on 11 November 2026.
